title: Better Voxels
description: Rethinking Voxels Fork | Every legendary feature you ever wanted in a shader. Combined. Optimized. Perfected.
body:
## Features
* **Voxel Global Illumination:** Advanced path-traced lighting optimized for Iris performance.
* **Eclipse Mechanics:** Dynamic, persistent tracking during solar and lunar transitions.
* **Camera Effects:** Procedural water droplets and screen-space focal depth blurring.

## Post-Processing
* **CRT Mode:** Retro VCR shader pass recreating classic scanlines and phosphor bloom.
* **ASCII Mode:** Real-time character grid transformation across the full viewport.
* **BodyCam Mode:** Ultra-immersive fish-eye lens perspective with auto-exposure logic.

## Options
* Everything listed above is modular. Every single visual effect can be fully adjusted or turned off via the in-game shader configuration menu!

## License & Credits
* **License:** Complimentary Agreement 1.3. This project is a fork of [Rethinking Voxels](https://modrinth.com/shader/rethinking-voxels) (by gri573), which is based on [Complementary Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound) by EminGT. Original copyright notices and terms of the license are strictly retained.
* **Lead Developer:** FastdropX
* **Modding Policy:** Out of respect for the project, please notify the developer or open a pull request before releasing heavy modifications.
* **Credits:** 
  * gri573 (For the incredible voxel path-tracing implementation in Rethinking Voxels).
  * EminGT (The creator of the foundational Complementary Shaders framework).
  * Xonk (Eclipse transition algorithms).
  * Original community contributors behind the base CRT, ASCII, and BodyCam screen matrices.

- EWZ
